title: docs(adr): ADR-0085 note records pinOverview and fieldTabs as ruled exceptions
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoGXWW2TwpGmA9mxtBrvWL1y)_

Fixes #37800
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：架构决策记录里新增一段带日期的说明，记下你 11 月 27 日的裁定，把记录详情页的两个对象级布局配置（概览是否钉在左栏、把指定字段分组放成概览之后的页签）列为裁定例外，产品行为不变。
- 这是你当天在席位线程提的记录页布局需求的第一步：现行决策拒收只重排页面的配置，例外先记进决策记录，后面两张实现卡才能开工。
- 这段话如果把范围写宽或写错，两张实现卡会照着做；它只是文档，发现不对可以直接再改一版撤回，不影响任何已上线的页面。
- 这是受管文件（人合档），需要你本人审阅并合并。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0085-object-semantic-roles-over-surface-hint-blocks.md`: one dated blockquote Note (2026-11-27) inside `### 2. The admission test for future keys`, directly after the 2026-11-23 `actionLayout` Note and before `### 3. Deletions`. 31 lines added, none removed, no heading added. The Note says five things:

1. The sentence "keys that merely hide/re-arrange correct information are rejected at this layer" now yields in three places: `relatedLists` (2026-11-20), `actionLayout` (2026-11-23) and this ruling, which carries two object keys, `pinOverview` and `fieldTabs`. Both are ruled exceptions. Like the `actionLayout` Note, it does not claim that either key passes the admission test.
2. The ruling: the maintainer's words of 2026-11-27 (03:36Z and 03:40Z) and his choice on the 04:07Z decision card, quoted verbatim in Chinese, with links to the two GitHub records (comment 7209632085 on the ADR card, comment 7209608089 on the `pinOverview` card). His 03:51Z question about the `relatedList` syntax ended with `relatedLists` kept, unrenamed and unchanged.
3. Each key's scope. `pinOverview`: whether the overview pins to the left column, on the wide (desktop) full page of the synthesized record page only, where pinning is otherwise derived. `fieldTabs`: named field groups leave the overview and are drawn as tabs right after it. An object that declares neither draws as before. The keys are not in the spec until their implementing cards land; `ObjectSchema` is strict and refuses both until then.
4. The object-level `fieldTabs` is not the form-level `FormSchema.fieldTabs` that the `@object-ui` form renderer reads (beside `defaultFieldTab` and `fieldTabsPosition`): the same word at a different layer, and the Note rules only the object key.
5. What stays refused: the guard keeps its force for every other key. Any other object key that only hides or only re-arranges still needs its own ruling, above all per-page show/hide switches.

Nothing else is in the diff: no `packages/**`, no `skills/**`, no changeset (an ADR-only diff publishes nothing, hence `skip-changeset`). The two implementing cards, #37792 (`pinOverview`) and #37802 (`fieldTabs`), remain open and wait on this Note.

## Tests

No test is added: the diff is ADR prose, and docs are not ablated. What was checked instead is every claim the Note makes, against the cards and against the tree.

<details><summary>Readings (head 33b946d3, repository objectstack-ai/objectstack)</summary>

- Quotes: all four Chinese quotes in the Note were compared byte for byte with the bodies of the three cards (the ADR card, the `pinOverview` card, the `fieldTabs` card); each quote is found in all three bodies.
- Premise, read on the base commit 30a8047b: `git grep pinOverview` over the tree: 0 hits; `git grep fieldTabs -- packages/spec`: 0 hits; `git grep fieldTabs -- skills`: 0 hits; control word `relatedLists` in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`: 56 hits. `fieldTabs` occurs only under `ui/` (20 files), all of it the form-level key.
- Tree claims in the Note: `recordPagePinsDetails` is declared in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordPageColumns.ts` (line 180) and returns false off a full page or under `RECORD_PAGE_PIN_MIN_WIDTH`; `FormSchema` in `ui/packages/types/src/form.ts` declares `fieldTabs` (line 2584), `defaultFieldTab` (2588) and `fieldTabsPosition` (2593), and the form renderer reads them in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`; `ObjectSchemaBase` is a `strictObject` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, line 4092).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 21 derived commands for the one changed path, all run locally at this head, each exit code captured before any pipe, all 0. `--ran` reconciliation: `21 derived, 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- `pnpm check:adr-anchors`: exit 0, `check-adr-anchors: OK (135 anchored file(s), every governing ADR still referenced; ...)`.
- `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`: exit 0, `check-adr-symbol-anchors: 4477 anchors across 164 records resolve`. The shared extractor reads two anchors off the new lines: the symbol anchor on `recordPagePinsDetails` and the file-level anchor on `ui/packages/types/src/form.ts`.
- `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`: exit 0, `1263 relative link destination(s) under docs/adr/ resolve`. `pnpm check:adr-index`: exit 0, `docs/adr/README.md is current`.
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring`: exit 0. `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: exit 0, `no raw ASCII control bytes`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`: first run exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (two workspace packages not built), which is not a reading; after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint --concurrency=2` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0), exit 0.
- The other derived commands, each exit 0: `check-adr-links.mjs --self-test`, `check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`, `ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-prior-rulings`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:watch-hint-literal`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's step 2 (teach the two keys in `skills/**`) is deliberately not in this PR, by the claim's file surface. `ObjectSchema` is strict, so a skill that taught either key before its spec change lands would have authors write a key that `os validate` refuses. The teaching lands with each key, on the two implementing cards.
- The Note records the ruling and its scope, not the design. Value shapes and first-version limits (which values of `pinOverview` change anything, the entry shape of `fieldTabs`, whether an object extension may carry either key) stay on the implementing cards; the ADR text does not fix them.
- The ruling was made in the seat thread, not on GitHub. The two linked comments are the fleet's records of it: 7209608089 carries the 04:07Z choice in the maintainer's words, 7209632085 records that the ADR card was filed from that decision card. The quotes themselves are on the card bodies, which is why the Note says so.
- "Three places" counts rulings, not keys: the third place carries two keys. The Note says this in so many words.
- Length: the Note is 30 lines against 19 for the `actionLayout` Note. It carries two keys, four quotes and six links where that one carries one key, two quotes and five links.
- No line-number anchor is written into the ADR (the symbol-anchor gate refuses them); the line numbers above are readings for this PR only.
- The checkout is shallow, so no date in the Note was read from `git log`; every date and time comes from the cards.
- This diff touches `docs/adr/**`, a Tier H governed surface. The PR is opened as a draft and stays one; landing is the maintainer's.

## Verification

Read first: the single hunk in `docs/adr/0085-object-semantic-roles-over-surface-hint-blocks.md`. The riskiest sentences are the two scope sentences (`pinOverview` says ..., `fieldTabs` names ...), because the implementing cards will be held to them, and the count ("There are now three").

Two-minute check: `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` — expect the last line to read `check-adr-symbol-anchors: 4477 anchors across 164 records resolve`, which includes the Note's two anchors.
